description: Official Mass Mobilization latest version, country universe, current schema, final ccode and reuse terms remain unverified; ccode 375 is provisional.
required_followup: Coordinator must resolve the official-baseline gate before consolidation or any official compatibility claim.

description: FI-S005 reports roughly ten attendees at the STOP NATO flash-mob, while FI-S003 gives no crowd count. The estimate has no independent corroboration, so the 50-person threshold is unresolved.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporaneous estimate or authoritative count; do not infer attendance from organizers, police deployment, photos, or repeated affiliated headlines.

description: FI-S005 reports opposition to Finland’s NATO membership alongside opposition to U.S. presence. Whether an explicit demand addressed Finnish government policy, rather than the U.S. Embassy or NATO generally, needs confirmation.
required_followup: Review a contemporaneous independent account or organizer statement and record the precise demand and its addressee.

description: FI-S003 reports a Helsinki anti-NATO demonstration during the week before 31 January; FI-S005 reports a 28 January STOP NATO flash-mob. Their shared time, place and theme suggest a possible match, not a verified identity.
required_followup: Compare additional independent reporting or primary records before linking the reports to one episode; do not count the match as independent corroboration.

description: FI-S001 remains unread after a public web Cache miss and an ordinary HTTPS DNS-resolution failure before HTTP. The date and location in its search headline do not prove an executed gathering.
required_followup: Do not retry the already-attempted exact URL. Seek independent corroboration only from another separately screened public URL; any new body target requires the live generation-4 window, exact card/receipt match, fresh full-scope review and immediate pre-request gate check.

description: The FI-S001 headline associates a demonstration with 30 January, but actual physical start, schedule and endpoint are unverified. FI-S003 gives only a relative “last week” window for its anti-NATO event.
required_followup: Use contemporary event evidence to distinguish an announced date, article date and physical start/end; leave unknown values null.

description: Yle reports police contact with an organizer about a planned Quran burning that was abandoned; MV-Lehti reports a police warning to a journalist. Neither establishes a response to the STOP NATO political demand or the coded response categories.
required_followup: Seek an event-specific police account or independent contemporary report; keep all response fields unknown until supported.

description: FI-S004 and FI-S005 are similarly framed advocacy-oriented STOP NATO accounts; their relationship and independence are unresolved. Yle FI-S003 is a separate outlet but does not explicitly identify the 28 January event or crowd size.
required_followup: Check written-story origins and obtain independent evidence for any duplicated facts; do not count same-origin accounts as separate confirmation.

description: Forty-two captured open-web searches (848 ordered headers) include Finnish, Swedish and English terms, national and selected regional outlets, event-specific leads, and selected police, student and labor routes. They are not a systematic archive review or complete regional/sector coverage.
required_followup: If further work is authorized, target uncovered regional labor, education, public-service and local archive sources for 1–31 January, capturing all native results; distinguish a no-result search from evidence that no event occurred.

description: Searches included Finnish, Swedish and English, but the dossier has not had fluent independent review of Finnish/Swedish wording and regional archives.
required_followup: Have a fluent Finnish and Swedish reviewer check local terms, the two Helsinki leads and regional reporting; retain the original phrases alongside translations.

description: Systematic late-December 2022 and February 2023 boundary searches have not established whether any January lead continued from a prior month or continued into February.
required_followup: Search adjacent-month reporting for start and closure evidence; record pre-January starts as continuations rather than January events.

description: This dossier uses open-web search and selected public pages; it does not reproduce the original LexisNexis search. The official baseline and original current coding procedure remain unresolved.
required_followup: Keep the method deviation and access limitations explicit; coordinator must resolve baseline and procedure questions independently.
